say: Tonight was supposed to be romantic. It's been mostly cold and a bit wet.
Not the night I planned, {owner}. Not the night I planned at all.
@how_are_things

options.text: I'm sorry. What would make it better?
It's an old building. Bear with us.
Rinks are hard. Take it or leave it.

say: We're here for {event}! I'm going to hold the boards and look casual.
This is our second date. Or third. I'm counting this one twice if I don't fall.
Okay. I can skate. Mostly forwards. Is backwards a requirement?

options.text: You'll do great. Just keep moving.
Have fun out there.

say: Night skate! The lights, the music, the cold. Very romantic. Very cold.
We came late so fewer people could see us fall. It's a strategy.

options.text: Good to see you anyway.

say: Hey {owner}! Remember us? We're still together. The rink gets some credit.
{owner}! We told everybody about this place. Well, our friends. Well, two friends.

options.text: Good to see you too, {known_as}.

say: @how_are_things
Hi! Sorry, I'm still warming up my hands. And my courage.
Oh, hi. Is this a good time? It's always a good time. Unless I'm falling.

options.text: So what do you love about public skate?
What brings you to the rink?
What do you make of the rink?
Have you met anyone nice here?
What would make this place better for you?
Take care.

say: You go round and round and talk and nobody can leave. It's the perfect date.
It's cheap, it's cozy and you have an excuse to hold hands. For balance. Mostly.
The music's always ten years old. It's very comforting.

options.text: Sounds like a good night out.
Tell me a bit about yourself.
Glad you come.
Good to know you, {known_as}.

say: It's sweet in here. Old, but sweet. Like a grandparent's basement with ice.
The rental skates are... a choice. I can't feel my left foot.
@ice

options.text: The ice has been better lately, hasn't it?
Noticed the work on the building?
Fair enough. We're working on it.

say: The ice is so smooth now! I only fell once and it was a choice.
Good ice. We actually glided. Like people in a movie.

options.text: Glad it shows.

say: The lobby's actually nice now. We sat and had hot chocolate. Like a cafe. A cold cafe.
The washrooms are lovely now. I'm not saying that's romantic. But it helps.

options.text: That's the idea.

say: There's an older lady, Irene, who's been skating here since 1974. She waved at us. We felt blessed.
Doreen on the organ played a slow song for us. I think. Or it was a dirge for a missed call.

options.text: Ha. Good to know.

say: A couples skate. Dim lights, slow songs, maybe a little disco ball. Just a little one.
Make Saturday night special. Lights down, music up. We'd come every week.

options.text: I'll see what I can do.
Can't promise anything, but noted.
You're not the first to say it. It's on the list.

say: Okay. We're going back out. Wish us luck. Mostly me.
Good night, {owner}! We'll be back. If we're still a we.
